policy: A staged term that is the SAME ingredient, SAME plant part and SAME form as an existing lexicon row is a synonym of that row (synonyms.csv), never a new lexicon row. A DIFFERENT plant part (coriander leaf vs coriander seed, dill weed vs dill seed) or a different species (peppermint, spearmint vs mint) may be a separate row. A bare base term that is ambiguous between parts (coriander, dill) is left untouched and is not widened. Any staged term that overlaps a conditioned clause is parked, not decided.
check: scripts/validate_batch.py blocks the gate when a ready row is a variant of an existing row (shares a whole word-sequence boundary with one) and this file neither maps it to a synonym nor keeps it as a separate row.

anise seed.basis: same ingredient, same plant part (seed), same form as the existing row

caraway seed.basis: same ingredient, same plant part (seed), same form as the existing row

cumin seed.basis: same ingredient, same plant part (seed), same form as the existing row

fenugreek seed.basis: same ingredient, same plant part (seed), same form as the existing row

separate_rows.coriander leaf: different plant part from coriander seed
separate_rows.coriander seed: different plant part from coriander leaf; the existing bare row 'coriander' is ambiguous between parts and is left untouched (not widened)
separate_rows.dill weed: different plant part (leaf) from dill seed; the existing bare row 'dill' is left untouched (not widened)
separate_rows.dill seed: different plant part (seed) from dill weed; the existing bare row 'dill' is left untouched (not widened)
separate_rows.peppermint: different species from 'mint' (bare mint is an existing row)
separate_rows.spearmint: different species from 'mint' (bare mint is an existing row)

poppy seed.reason: FAO Table 1 Group 1 also lists 'tree and ground nuts and other oily seeds (with no added salt or sugar)': a conditioned clause. Poppy seed sits on the boundary between that clause and the unconditioned herbs-and-spices clause; the boundary is unresolved, so it is parked (same discipline as the juice rows).

untouched_base_rows_note: Bare 'coriander' (PROVISIONAL author seed) and bare 'dill' (research/02 synthetic example) are existing rows that do not say leaf or seed. They are left as they are.
